gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Graceful and flat, Bevellier keeps every stroke at a single pencil-like weight. Hedvig Letters Sans brings approachable small letters that rise nearly to capital height, and that tall, friendly stance is what the pair does best.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hind-guntur: Stencil-cut and flat, with letters packed shoulder to shoulder. Bevellier takes the sophisticated top spot, while Hind Guntur keeps wide gaps between curves and stems, like stamped metal type.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-kedebideri: Single-weight, stencil-cut strokes give Bevellier its flat, graceful look. Kedebideri sits below with rounded, inviting letters and a skyward x-height, which makes the stencil-flat heading look all the more deliberate.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-martel-sans: Flat, tight and stencil-sharp, with no stroke contrast at all. Bevellier is best at striking display lettering, while Martel Sans is best at open curves and a high mean line across every word.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-miriam-libre: Flat stencil cuts and tight spacing give Bevellier a graceful, sophisticated look. And Miriam Libre, with its wire-weight strokes and capital-like lowercase stature, gives the pair a sturdy, approachable footing.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-nokora: Neon-tube lines, one track width, cut flat and set close in Bevellier. Nokora, with a wide-open s and a thick, dark lowercase stripe, gives those uniform lines something sturdy to lean against.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Sophisticated and flat, Bevellier cuts every stroke, w included, at a single weight, with tight spacing and squat ascenders. Noto Sans Adlam gives it room: curve endings stay well apart.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Bevellier cuts flat, unmodulated strokes with very close sidebearings, giving the heading a sophisticated, stencil-made look at display sizes. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits below with generous space around its curves.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-: Graceful and flat, Bevellier holds every stroke at one thickness, with tight spacing and squat ascenders beneath a high, wide-looking lowercase. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads modern, its tall x-height easing paragraphs along.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic reads clean and modern, with wide openings on small letters. Under Bevellier, with its signage-plain close-set lines, the pronounced x-height keeps running text moving smoothly along.
